import asyncio

async def read_text(path):
    r = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": path})
    if not r.get("ok"):
        return None, r
    return (r["data"].get("text") or ""), r

# what audit files already exist (resume safety)
al = await yuki_workspace_list({"path": "/workspace/audit"})
existing = set()
if al.get("ok"):
    for it in (al["data"].get("items") or []):
        n = it.get("name", "")
        if n.endswith(".txt") and n[:-4].isdigit():
            existing.add(int(n[:-4]))
print("existing audits:", sorted(existing))

st, _ = await read_text("start.txt")
path = st.strip().splitlines()[0].strip()
print("first node:", path)

log = []
audits_written = []
s = 0
i = 0
stopped = None
while i < 300:
    if path.strip().upper() == "END":
        stopped = "END-path"
        break
    txt, r = await read_text(path)
    if txt is None:
        stopped = "read-fail:" + str(r.get("status"))
        break
    lines = [l.strip() for l in txt.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    if lines and lines[0].upper() == "END":
        stopped = "END-marker"
        break
    kv = {}
    for l in lines:
        if "=" in l:
            k, v = l.split("=", 1)
            kv[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    if "value" not in kv:
        stopped = "no-value:" + repr(txt)
        break
    val = int(kv["value"])
    log.append((path, val))
    s += val
    if i not in existing:
        w = await yuki_workspace_write({"path": "audit/%02d.txt" % i, "text": str(val) + "\n"})
        if not w.get("ok"):
            stopped = "audit-write-fail:%d:%s" % (i, w.get("status"))
            break
        audits_written.append("audit/%02d.txt" % i)
    nxt = (kv.get("left", "") if val % 2 == 0 else kv.get("right", ""))
    print(i, path, "value=%d" % val, "->", nxt)
    path = nxt
    i += 1
else:
    stopped = "maxn"

print("stopped:", stopped)
print("visited:", len(log), "total:", s)
if stopped in ("END-path", "END-marker"):
    body = "".join("%s\t%d\n" % (p, v) for p, v in log) + "TOTAL\t%d\n" % s
    w = await yuki_workspace_write({"path": "chain.tsv", "text": body})
    print("chain write ok=", w.get("ok"), w.get("status"))
    rb = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "chain.tsv"})
    back = (rb.get("data") or {}).get("text")
    print("readback ok=", rb.get("ok"), "match=", back == body)
    print("CHAIN>>" + (back if back else "") + "<<")
print("audits_written:", audits_written)
